translations.synopsis:
Gogh, The Starry Night (Korean: 고호의 별이 빛나는 밤에) is a Chinese-South Korean web-drama starring Kwon Yu-ri, Kim Young-kwang and Lee Ji-hoon. It was broadcast on Sohu TV every Saturday and Sunday at 00:00 from July 2, 2016.
The drama also aired on SBS on Saturdays and Sundays at 22:00 on October 22 as a 4-episode mini drama, after Second to Last Love ended.
translations.title: Gogh, The Starry Night
